meta.title: Action Automation architecture
meta.description: Implemented Electron action automation: renderer control, scheduled and interactive orchestration, definition resolution, chained command or agent execution, worktree coordination, diagram completion, run events, and project-backed persistence.

nodes.label: Action Controls
nodes.sublabel: Action popup, card triggers, editor, and schedule form initiate and interact with runs

nodes.label: Renderer Run Registry
nodes.sublabel: Owns renderer-side run stores, recovery, waiting promises, context bindings, and active-run subscriptions

nodes.label: Action IPC Bridge
nodes.sublabel: Preload and local bridge dispatch expose whitelisted action requests and stream run events across the Electron boundary

nodes.label: Action Runner Service
nodes.sublabel: Owns project action runtime, active and recoverable runs, conversation reservations, run control, and event publication

nodes.label: Action Scheduler Service
nodes.sublabel: Persists one-time schedules, reconciles bounded timers, starts unattended runs, and records terminal schedule status

nodes.label: Action Definition Resolution
nodes.sublabel: Indexes action IDs, lazily loads linked definitions, validates graphs against profiles and states, and resolves built-ins

nodes.label: Action Run Orchestrator
nodes.sublabel: Executes onBefore, main, conditional on, and onAfter phases; handles cancellation, auto-finish, output, commits, and final activity

nodes.label: Action Worktree Coordinator
nodes.sublabel: Serializes runs per card and resolves primary, assigned worktree, or merge-conflict repository context

nodes.label: Command Action Executor
nodes.sublabel: Resolves action placeholders, spawns shell commands in the selected repository, streams output, and terminates cancelled process trees

nodes.label: Agent Action Executor
nodes.sublabel: Builds prompts and continuation requests, binds activity conversations, and adapts action runs to the agent runtime

nodes.label: Agent Runner Service
nodes.sublabel: Spawns provider processes, parses streaming protocols, handles questions and approvals, checkpoints conversations, and reports usage

nodes.label: Diagram Output Watcher
nodes.sublabel: Watches the allocated diagram JSON path and requests auto-finish only after shared diagram-data validation succeeds

nodes.label: Project Change Watcher
nodes.sublabel: Publishes project file changes used to reconcile externally modified schedule state

nodes.label: Worktree and Merge Conflict Services
nodes.sublabel: Resolve configured linked worktrees and active merge-conflict sessions to repository roots and branches

nodes.label: Local Git Service
nodes.sublabel: Provides action and schedule file access, activity and conversation persistence, tracked commits, commit metadata, and worktree operations

nodes.label: Desktop Agent Configuration
nodes.sublabel: Electron-store configuration supplies agent profiles, commands, models, permission modes, and thinking levels

nodes.label: Local Git Project
nodes.sublabel: Stores action JSON, .md2-schedules.json, activity and conversation files, generated diagrams, working-tree changes, and Git history

nodes.label: Shell Command Process
nodes.sublabel: Operating-system shell process launched for command actions

nodes.label: Agent CLI Process
nodes.sublabel: Codex, Claude, or another configured agent executable and streaming protocol
